summary: Iteration 125 - full backend + frontend test of the Phase 4 GRN enhancements (Site/Warehouse selection with bound-site auto-lock, Supplier Doc Num, discrepancy mark/auto-clear, 2-step live SAP write tracking). Backend: 12/12 pytest cases pass (/api/admin/grn/sites, /warehouses/{site}, /discrepancy, /approve, /reject, /retry-movement, vendor PUT auto-clear). Frontend: staff GRN page (site auto-lock to P2 + disabled, 8 real P2 warehouses, doc-num input, approve client-side guard, discrepancy dialog validation x3 negative cases, discrepancy banner, Mark-Discrepancy hidden while Approve/Reject stay, approve->two status boxes, reject from in_transit, unknown-code error) and vendor portal (Discrepancy badge on row + detail modal + reason + flagged items, discrepancy status filter, Edit available and edit auto-clears back to In Transit) all verified working end-to-end. Expected dummy-PO SAP rejection on step 1 with step 2 correctly skipped (not_applicable) - not flagged as a bug per the request. Only minor UI/perf issues found; no functional defects.

minor.issue: Observed a 46.7s response once and a hard 502 (ingress 60s cut-off) on a cold call. inventory_service.list_known_sites() loads the entire single inventory_cache doc (projection items.locations.site) on every request. When it exceeds 60s the GRN page shows a 'Could not load sites' toast, the Site dropdown stays empty and staff cannot approve at all. Recommend a precomputed/cached site list (or a tiny separate doc) instead of scanning the whole snapshot per request. Repeat calls after a fresh backend start were 0.4-0.5s.

403 for the store-bound GRN user (only has supplier_portal_admin). The SapConnectionStatus widget on the GRN page therefore always renders a red 'SAP Disconnected' badge for exactly the users who own this page - misleading. Either exclude the widget from this page or don't page-gate the connection-status probe.

ui_bugs.issue: When sap_movement_status === 'not_applicable' (step 1 didn't post, step 2 legitimately skipped) the amber box reads 'Warehouse movement pending (target P2/P2-QC)'. It should say the movement was skipped because the Goods Receipt has not posted yet, otherwise staff think there is an actionable pending movement (no Retry button is shown, correctly).

The raw SAP SOAP fault envelope (full XML, ~400 chars incl. namespaces) is dumped verbatim into the status box. Should surface a short human message (e.g. 'SAP rejected the Goods Receipt - transaction ID xxx') with the raw fault behind a collapsible/tooltip.

issues: Header shows a red 'SAP Disconnected' pill for the store-bound GRN user due to the 403 above (false alarm)
Pending Shipments table refresh after Approve is fire-and-forget (loadPending not awaited), so the just-approved row can linger for a moment before disappearing - cosmetic only, it does clear

action_items: Cache/precompute the site list behind GET /api/admin/grn/sites - a cold call took 46.7s and 502'd once, which blocks GRN approval entirely
Fix the 'not_applicable' movement copy on grn-sap-movement-status (say 'skipped - Goods Receipt not posted' instead of 'pending')
Stop showing 'SAP Disconnected' / calling /api/bom/connection-status on the GRN page for users without bom_explorer access (403 today)
Truncate/collapse the raw SOAP fault XML in the SAP posting status box
critical_code_review_comments: supplier_shipment_service.approve_shipment docstring still claims step 2 lands stock 'as RESTRICTED Quality Inspection stock' - contradicts the confirmed tenant limitation documented in _post_goods_movement_for_items (plain move only). Update the docstring so future readers aren't misled.

supplier_shipment_service._post_goods_movement_for_items hardcodes the movement SOURCE as f'{site_id}-RM'; for a receipt that SAP actually landed elsewhere this will keep failing. Consider making the source configurable/derivable rather than a convention baked into code.

GET /api/admin/grn/shipments and /api/admin/grn/lookup/{code} are NOT site-scoped (any authorised GRN user sees/looks up every site's shipments) while approve/retry-movement ARE site-gated - inconsistent; confirm this is intended.
inventory_service.list_known_sites() is now on a page-load critical path but does a full-document scan of the inventory_cache snapshot on every call - see the 46.7s/502 observation.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (2 minor copy/widget issues)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend tests with `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_grn_discrepancy_iter125.py -n0 -p no:randomly -v` (pytest.ini forces xdist loadscope which breaks these ordered, shared-fixture tests). IMPORTANT ENVIRONMENT GOTCHA: writing/deleting ANY file under /app/backend (including tests/) triggers uvicorn --reload; the old worker's non-daemon SAP background threads (30s-timeout OData calls) keep the old process alive, so the backend returns 502/timeouts for 1-4 minutes after every file touch. Put seed/helper scripts under /app/tests instead, and sleep or `sudo supervisorctl restart backend` before hitting the API. Fixture POs TESTGRN1 (items 1,2) / TESTGRN2 (item 1) for S9999 still have plenty of open qty. Discrepancy flow, site/warehouse gating, and the 2-step approve are fully covered; PO table/cart flows were not re-tested this iteration.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defects found. The observed /api/admin/grn/sites 46.7s/502 traces to inventory_service.list_known_sites() reading and iterating the whole inventory_cache document per request; it is fast (0.5s) when Mongo/thread-pool is idle but degrades badly while the background inventory/valuation refresh is running, and the ingress cuts off at 60s. The dummy-PO SAP GSA HTTP 500 (real SOAP fault with transaction ID) and the resulting sap_movement_status='not_applicable' are correct expected behaviour, not bugs.
